dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Mild concave curvature along the posterior margin extending from the dorsal insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a broad pixel radius; non-acute termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderate angular steepness, approximately 40-50 degrees relative to the dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of longitudinal base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex, smooth curvature with a consistent radius across the anterior-dorsal surface.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered protrusion with a high thickness-to-length ratio visible at the anterior terminus.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle where the ventral slope of the melon meets the dorsal plane of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cyan-hued subsurface light scattering effect across the entirety of the visible epidermis.
